subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_bias_generator_reference iref_snk vdd
M1 iref_snk iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
.ends pmos_bias_generator_reference
subcircuits.role_hint: Bias generation network using diode-connected PMOS M1. An external sink current at iref_snk establishes the PMOS current-source gate bias that biases M2 and M5.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt error_amplifier_input_stage gnd iref_snk vdd vin fb net7
M4 net7 vin net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M3 net6 fb net5 vdd pmos l=l_eai_p w=w_eai_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M2 net5 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
M8 net6 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M7 net7 net6 gnd gnd nmos l=l_eal_n w=w_eal_n*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
.ends error_amplifier_input_stage
subcircuits.role_hint: Core error-amplifier input stage. M2 provides PMOS tail/source bias, M3-M4 form the PMOS differential input pair comparing vin against fb, and M7-M8 form the NMOS current-mirror active load producing the single-ended internal output net7.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt pmos_gate_driver_stage gnd iref_snk vdd net7 net2
M6 gnd net7 net2 vdd pmos l=l_eab_p w=w_eab_p*1 m=1 nf=1 sd=220.0n
M5 net2 iref_snk vdd vdd pmos l=l_cs_p w=w_cs_p*1 m=1 nf=1
.ends pmos_gate_driver_stage
subcircuits.role_hint: Second signal-path gain/level-shift gate-driver stage. M5 supplies bias current from vdd using the iref_snk PMOS bias voltage, while M6 converts the error-amplifier output net7 into the pass-device gate-drive node net2.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt ldo_pass_device_feedback_stage gnd vdd net2 vo fb
M0 vo net2 vdd vdd pmos l=l_power_p w=w_power_p*1 m=1 nf=1
R1 vo fb res r1
R2 fb gnd res r2
.ends ldo_pass_device_feedback_stage
subcircuits.role_hint: LDO power output and feedback network. M0 is the PMOS pass transistor controlled by net2, while R1-R2 sense the regulated output vo and generate the feedback voltage fb for the error amplifier.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt series_rc_miller_compensation net7 vo
C0 net7 net1 cap c0
R0 net1 vo res r0
.ends series_rc_miller_compensation
subcircuits.role_hint: Series RC compensation network from the error-amplifier internal node net7 to the LDO output vo. It provides frequency compensation and zero placement for regulator loop stability.

subcircuits.netlist:
.subckt output_load_capacitor vo GND
CL vo GND cap cload
.ends output_load_capacitor
subcircuits.role_hint: Output load capacitor connected from the regulated output node vo to ground, modeling the external or on-chip LDO load capacitance.
